answer: Per-identity uniqueness challenge: every agent must clear a recurring human-liveness test (biometric gesture plus timed cognitive puzzle) every 30 days, not just once at signup. A farm of 200 fake identities pays roughly $18 per challenge per bot in operator time and failed-retry penalties, so sustaining the farm costs $3,600 monthly and climbs as retries multiply. One attacker tries a velvet-smooth deepfake spoofing a jade iris pattern through a spiral scan path; each spoof still costs $40 compute and risks permanent ban, so farms bleed money.
